evidence: Paired register permutations and chip-10 sign changes in 3C5/3DA suggest quarter-turn rotations. Q=0, byte order, carry feedback and virtual output slots are explicit assumptions.
limitations: The four quarter-turn identities are search constraints, not independent proof of the physical instruction wiring.
3EF is held out because output registers 12/13 overlap the source pair; sequential writes change its behavior.
Virtual output slots label modeled ALU-Y captures, not identified DAC or RAM addresses.
Carry selector 10.1 also fits these tables; choosing 11.0 is not established by this experiment.
